Those creatures!!!
Who's that?!
W-wait, we're not your enemies!!
Umm...You guys are weredragons, aren't you?\nBut unlike Zianga, you don't look like warriors.\nWhat are you guys doing here?
Oh, I'm Mubandi. This is my wife, Bibia, and my\nson Myu. We came from the lower level and we were\ntrying to go to Draco Town...
However, we got lost in Nebula Plain and when we\nentered this place, we were caught and detained by\nthe weredragons.
Why were you trying to go to Draco Town?
M-my father is sick and we wanted to go to Draco\nTown to visit him.
That's weird.\nThere is no sick old weredragon in town now tho?
Whaat?! T-that can't be true...
Oh my gosh! The Knight of Thorns!!
Hand over that weredragon couple and the baby...
Wait a sec, I'm not done questioning these two\nyet.
Moreover, there's no way I would hand my fellow\nweredragons to an unknown and suspicious guy\nlike you...!
You had better do what I say...
Shut up!!
Good grief, this isn't gonna get us anywhere...
...Now I know you guys have got a situation...
Besides, you don't seem to carry any weapon with\nyou. I assume you wouldn't do anything funny.
We'll take you to Draco Town once we're done with\nour business. For now you two are coming with us,\nokay?
O-okay. Thank you...
